release_notes: Domain-Partitioned Event-Driven Pipeline: Single-writer vox-router architecture across 6 interaction domains (Modular Passive/PTT, Realtime S2S, Dictation) with instant barge-in and warm audio pausing.
Sentient Cognitive Memory v2: 3D Fibonacci tree canopy with Fresnel core in Three.js, 2-stage deduplication (Jaccard + all-MiniLM-L6-v2 ONNX cosine), and rolling working compaction.
Dynamic Model Capability Catalog: Dynamic catalog supporting 4,500+ models with live TTFT/TPS probing, system-wide 8,192-token context floor, and unified cloud/local provider hub.
Realtime Duplex Voice Engine: Native bi-directional WebSocket streaming for Gemini Live and Deepgram Voice Agent alongside the on-device modular pipeline.
Native Turso SQLite MVCC Engine: Multi-version concurrency control with isolated connection pooling and transactional memory persistence.

linux.update_command: sudo apt update && sudo apt upgrade vox
